purpose: Common converter rule registry. A rule is applicable to every map only if its scope is 'global'; observations and hypotheses must be validated map-by-map.

gates.rule: Do not authorize Xbox deployment unless both final map fastfiles independently pass native T4Xenon OAT load with zero warnings and errors, plus required package dependency checks.
Do not copy unverified donor Xbox/retail FF payload bytes or fabricate converted XAsset graphs; stock references are name/identity evidence until proven loaded in the correct runtime zone.
Never inflate maps to hit an assumed minimum compressed FF size. Measure actual converted bytes and payload coverage.
Native asset order is dependency-driven. Do not assume PC root order or simple asset type sorting; verify native ScriptString indices and dependency closure.
Cache only outputs that satisfy their own validation stage and whose source hashes, context and implementation version still match.

gates.confidence: Jake suggested, not independently measured universal cutoff
gates.rule: A map was reported freezing above approximately 210 MiB runtime RAM. Do not infer runtime RAM from compressed FF size; collect actual runtime memory evidence per map.

FRUmansion FX promoted graph previously caused OAT invalid block 7 at asset #3345; tracked-shell variant passed. Fix serializer generically and run FRUmansion plus other maps through OAT regression, not blind promotion.
FRUmansion has 43 residual source images that were text references or failing PC-OAT image dumps; stock/UGX/ZCT scans did not prove owned image payloads. Never fill with arbitrary donors.

Aztec: 1903 typed PC static draws, 1902 source-owned model occurrences and 1 stock identity; 60B Xenon partial numeric array exists, but 0/1903 native pointer draw records linked. Do not mark Xbox-ready.
ZCT and UGX maps need profile-specific dependency evidence and sourcing. Do not assume generic vanilla-stock external sound/image rules cover them.
A .ff file path listing is a filename index, not a validated asset or dependency index. Record OAT-decoded asset names, source FF hashes, and ownership separately before reuse.
Original PC map-owned assets and patches take priority; extra_assets and other maps fill missing gaps only. Same-named stock Xbox replacement requires exact identity and correct platform graph.
Only the map zone and genuinely resident common.ff/code_post_gfx.ff/patch.ff can fulfill references during gameplay. ui.ff and patch_ui.ff are not gameplay-resident.

Resolve assets in map patch/mod/main and IWD, exact Xbox stock, stock PC game, PC campaign FFs, explicit extra_assets/UGX/ZCT, then other PC maps. Only read a candidate source FF when an independently indexed asset proves it can fill the gap.
Never silently blank critical world, collision, scripts, animations, animtrees, models or weapons; report unresolved dependencies with source and queried locations.
Cache zone asset-name indexes and exact source FF hashes across maps; share lookup results but not guessed asset payloads. A file-location-only index is not an asset index.

Rebuild each candidate zone and all block relocations from scratch; never reuse relocation offsets when memory-fitting moves asset bodies. Traverse whole typed dependency graph and independent readback after build.
Estimate decompressed zone and runtime budgets; reduce optional large textures / unneeded LODs only if the source map actually exceeds measured budget. Do not impose a minimum FF byte size.
Avoid downscaling critical HUD, reticle, hands, weapon models and their textures until all other eligible savings have been exhausted. Preserve original geometry/material relationships.
Xbox tiled mip/pitch and swizzle require native codec verification; simply byte-swapping PC IWI/DDS payloads is insufficient. Confirm actual T4Xenon textures/format before authorizing GPU resources.
Ensure spatial/3D sound aliases do not use unsupported multichannel stream payloads; preserve actual sample rate/loop points/codec format semantics in XMA.
Streamed audio must be a real console-usable stream, not a guessed alias to a loose file. Resolve and package validated paths and wrappers.
Prioritize scripts actually executed and their reachable dependencies; track script and animation-tree references without blindly replacing user code.
Recognize map/mod content from both mods and usermaps locations; merge only owned dependencies with provenance. Do not force UGX/ZCT or cross-mod override by default.
A distinct map _load FF may be needed for proper console loading presentation; cannot claim complete deployment from only main FF OAT pass.
Do not use unverified shader/techset donors or test-build byte blobs. Prove exact compatible Xenon shader graph and name, then bind with correct relocations.
Jake's probability-of-loading estimates are heuristic diagnostics and must not be interpreted as real console-test success or used as automatic release approval.
Source discovery should include local PC Maps, %LOCALAPPDATA% CoDWaW mods and usermaps, plus optional PC game and extra_assets folders, without hardcoded user home paths.
Independent ffcli/FastFileLib checks may supplement OAT but cannot replace required pinned native Xenon loader checks.
Avoid selecting alternate compressors/headers just because tools have matching magic; verify precise title/platform and original FF/zone block semantics.
